use IO.Std.write_line

class NODE[T](value: T) is
    next: NODE[T]?

    insert_after(value: T) -> NODE[T] is
        let inserted = NODE[T](value)

        inserted.next = next
        next = inserted

        inserted
    si
si

describe[T](node: NODE[T]?) -> string =>
    if let present = node then "{present.value}" else "none" fi

let a = NODE(1)
let b = a.insert_after(2)

write_line("a: value {a.value}, next {describe(a.next)}")
write_line("b: value {b.value}, next {describe(b.next)}")
output:
a: value 1, next 2
b: value 2, next none
